visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a white car interior, a middle-aged man with graying hair and sunglasses is seen in a medium shot, steering the wheel. Outside the window, another man wearing a blue and red Superman costume with a red cape appears to be flying alongside the vehicle against a cloudy sky. (2) The car window is rolled down. The man in the Superman costume knocks on the glass and points forward with an enthusiastic facial expression. (3) The Superman character hands a large green branded cup with a straw to the driver. The driver takes it, looking surprised and then pleased. (4) The scene shifts to product close-ups on a wooden surface, showing the cup's label featuring jasmine flowers and Chinese text. The light-colored milk tea is poured into a glass in a smooth, slow-motion shot. (5) The man in the costume is seen standing at a modern bright retail counter of a CoCo tea shop, interacting with a staff member in a black uniform. (6) Back in the car, the driver takes a sip and gives a thumbs-up to the camera. The Superman character performs a dramatic flying motion and disappears from the frame. (7) A wide-angle behind-the-scenes shot reveals the stationary car in a parking lot, with three crew members holding the Superman's cape and rocking the vehicle to simulate flight and motion.
